ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white central pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, bordered by low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edges and tips, creating a sharp bimodal intensity distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. A thick, irregular low-intensity black band follows the entire trailing edge. A distinct cluster of high-contrast black linear marks is localized on the mid-to-upper region of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees, partially obscured at the base by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. Serrations transition from low-amplitude waves near the notch to high-amplitude, jagged protrusions towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering into sharp, upwardly-angled lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of brown/grey circular protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of four distinct, dark-pigmented parallel linear marks (rake marks) crossing diagonally on the right lobe, with one perpendicular intersecting line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biofouling (barnacles) on the distal tips of both lobes; prominent dark-pigmented rake mark scarring on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated low-intensity focal spots (speckling) visible on the lower interior portion of the left lobe.
